description: Hand-reviewed prerequisite trees for the core courses of ten popular Twin Cities majors. Each tree encodes the standard course route from the official catalog text and the requirement registration enforces. Standing, major, college and minimum-grade rules are condition nodes that warn but never block. Instructor consent, graduate standing and broad 'or equivalent' escape hatches are omitted from the tree and noted. A concurrent course may be taken in the same term. An expression of null means no prerequisites.
